verdict.rationale: Buzz ships its own scriptable CLI covering channels, repos and workflow trigger/approve, and its agent runtime is described as "purpose-built for headless autonomous coding work". Remote agents also run without a desktop control channel. However, nothing documents running the product inside a CI pipeline: there is no CI recipe, no non-interactive auth guidance for CI runners, and no documented exit-code or output-format behavior, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented CI-pipeline usage (e.g. GitHub Actions or other runner examples), non-interactive/token auth guidance for CI, machine-readable output and exit-code contract, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
